description: This Java class configures and provides Spring beans for an Eclipse Hono CLI application. It sets up a Vert.x instance, address resolver options, Hono client configuration, and an application client factory.

classes.name: AppConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class that defines Spring beans for Vert.x, address resolver options, Hono client properties, and client factory for the CLI application.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and configures a Vertx instance with custom options, including warning exception time and address resolver options.

methods.name: addressResolverOptions
methods.description: Provides an AddressResolverOptions object as a Spring bean, configured via the 'address.resolver' prefix.

methods.name: honoClientConfig
methods.description: Provides a ClientConfigProperties object as a Spring bean, configured via the 'hono.client' prefix.

methods.name: clientFactory
methods.description: Creates and provides an ApplicationClientFactory bean using the Vert.x instance and Hono connection.
